errorCategory.title: Authentication Required
errorCategory.description: Server returned 401. Response body: Status 401 - Error: Authentication required
errorCategory.guidance:
**Actual server response:** Status 401 - Error: Authentication required

**Likely cause:** Server returned 401 without a specific token/credentials message. Possible causes:
- Request routed to the wrong host/port
- Endpoint requires a scope or role the test user doesn't have
- Server rejected the request before any auth check ran

Inspect the server logs directly for context.

errorCategory.title: Permission Denied
errorCategory.description: User lacks permission to access this endpoint
errorCategory.guidance:
The authenticated user doesn't have permission for this endpoint.

**Possible causes:**
1. Endpoint requires specific role (admin, owner, etc.)
2. User doesn't own the resource being accessed
3. Missing or invalid authentication token

**Recommended action:**
Add requiresRole to your API definition to document the required permissions:
```json
{
  "endpoint": "/api/admin/rules/bid-price",
  "method": "POST",
  "requiresRole": ["admin"],  // or ["owner"], ["manager"], etc.
  "testability": "manual",
  "skipReason": "Requires elevated permissions"
}
```
